meta.title: Midgame Crisis
meta.description: The black pieces are relentless, and danger dogs our heels like an oncoming flood.

units.rawText: The Oasis, Zone F
units.displayText: The Oasis, Zone F

spans.text: The Oasis, Zone F

units.rawText: Magnhilda leads the retreat, the firepower terminal now finally in her sights as she dodges a series of projectiles.
units.displayText: Magnhilda leads the retreat, the firepower terminal now finally in her sights as she dodges a series of projectiles.

spans.text: Magnhilda leads the retreat, the firepower terminal now finally in her sights as she dodges a series of projectiles.

units.rawText: We'll be able to merge with the garrison of Zone F soon! Mai, how many Entropic jellyfish are behind us?
units.displayText: We'll be able to merge with the garrison of Zone F soon! Mai, how many Entropic jellyfish are behind us?

spans.text: We'll be able to merge with the garrison of Zone F soon! Mai, how many Entropic jellyfish are behind us?

units.rawText: About one fourth of them are following us!
units.displayText: About one fourth of them are following us!

spans.text: About one fourth of them are following us!

units.rawText: Hah, looks like luring them with operand-loaded balloons is pretty effective! Damn, good work, Mai!
units.displayText: Hah, looks like luring them with operand-loaded balloons is pretty effective! Damn, good work, Mai!

spans.text: Hah, looks like luring them with operand-loaded balloons is pretty effective! Damn, good work, Mai!

units.rawText: Ehehe, it's the balloons. Not even Entropics can resist a nice balloon...
units.displayText: Ehehe, it's the balloons. Not even Entropics can resist a nice balloon...

spans.text: Ehehe, it's the balloons. Not even Entropics can resist a nice balloon...

units.rawText: Bait them into the area with the buildings rigged to explode as planned, then give Octogen the signal!
units.displayText: Bait them into the area with the buildings rigged to explode as planned, then give Octogen the signal!

spans.text: Bait them into the area with the buildings rigged to explode as planned, then give Octogen the signal!

units.rawText: I'm putting him through, but are we... really going to sacrifice those buildings?
units.displayText: I'm putting him through, but are we... really going to sacrifice those buildings?

spans.text: I'm putting him through, but are we... really going to sacrifice those buildings?

units.rawText: Of course! <size=40>Boom!</size>
units.displayText: Of course! Boom!

spans.text: Of course!
Boom!

units.rawText: Uwah!
units.displayText: Uwah!

spans.text: Uwah!

units.rawText: Compared to leaving these buildings to be infected, they're far better off being used to get rid of them!
units.displayText: Compared to leaving these buildings to be infected, they're far better off being used to get rid of them!

spans.text: Compared to leaving these buildings to be infected, they're far better off being used to get rid of them!

units.rawText: Uhh, don't you just want to blow things up...?
units.displayText: Uhh, don't you just want to blow things up...?

spans.text: Uhh, don't you just want to blow things up...?

units.rawText: Hahahaha, do you really need to ask?
units.displayText: Hahahaha, do you really need to ask?

spans.text: Hahahaha, do you really need to ask?

units.rawText: As the Magnhilda and Octogen's teams merge, Zone F lights up with explosions one after the other, consuming the Entropic jellyfish amidst the fire and smoke.
units.displayText: As the Magnhilda and Octogen's teams merge, Zone F lights up with explosions one after the other, consuming the Entropic jellyfish amidst the fire and smoke.

spans.text: As the Magnhilda and Octogen's teams merge, Zone F lights up with explosions one after the other, consuming the Entropic jellyfish amidst the fire and smoke.

units.rawText: The Oasis, Zone G secondary defense line, temporary command center.
units.displayText: The Oasis, Zone G secondary defense line, temporary command center.

spans.text: The Oasis, Zone G secondary defense line, temporary command center.

units.rawText: Zone F is proceeding as planned! Projected to complete the mission within half an hour, same as Zone H.
units.displayText: Zone F is proceeding as planned! Projected to complete the mission within half an hour, same as Zone H.

spans.text: Zone F is proceeding as planned! Projected to complete the mission within half an hour, same as Zone H.

units.rawText: We've lured some of the Entropic jellyfish to Zones F and H, but the High Order Entropic is bound to advance further into Zone G. What are your plans, Persicaria?
units.displayText: We've lured some of the Entropic jellyfish to Zones F and H, but the High Order Entropic is bound to advance further into Zone G. What are your plans, Persicaria?

spans.text: We've lured some of the Entropic jellyfish to Zones F and H, but the High Order Entropic is bound to advance further into Zone G. What are your plans, Persicaria?

units.rawText: Don't worry. Sol, Antonina, and I will remain in Zone G and use existing defense lines to slow its progress wherever we can.
units.displayText: Don't worry. Sol, Antonina, and I will remain in Zone G and use existing defense lines to slow its progress wherever we can.

spans.text: Don't worry. Sol, Antonina, and I will remain in Zone G and use existing defense lines to slow its progress wherever we can.

units.rawText: When you take care of the Entropic jellyfish in your respective Zones, return to base. We'll handle it once it's isolated.
units.displayText: When you take care of the Entropic jellyfish in your respective Zones, return to base. We'll handle it once it's isolated.

spans.text: When you take care of the Entropic jellyfish in your respective Zones, return to base. We'll handle it once it's isolated.

units.rawText: Understood, we'll make quick work of these Entropic jellyfish!
units.displayText: Understood, we'll make quick work of these Entropic jellyfish!

spans.text: Understood, we'll make quick work of these Entropic jellyfish!

units.rawText: Never thought you'd have made such extensive preparations.
units.displayText: Never thought you'd have made such extensive preparations.

spans.text: Never thought you'd have made such extensive preparations.

units.rawText: We did infer previously that there would be more than two of these Entropic jellyfish. Though we never could have imagined that their numbers would be this ridiculous...
units.displayText: We did infer previously that there would be more than two of these Entropic jellyfish. Though we never could have imagined that their numbers would be this ridiculous...

spans.text: We did infer previously that there would be more than two of these Entropic jellyfish. Though we never could have imagined that their numbers would be this ridiculous...

units.rawText: We can plan to eliminate the Entropic jellyfish, but if they can infinitely birth more...
units.displayText: We can plan to eliminate the Entropic jellyfish, but if they can infinitely birth more...

spans.text: We can plan to eliminate the Entropic jellyfish, but if they can infinitely birth more...

units.rawText: No matter what type of empowerment it is, in the cloud, it functions with the prerequisite of operand availability.
units.displayText: No matter what type of empowerment it is, in the cloud, it functions with the prerequisite of operand availability.

spans.text: No matter what type of empowerment it is, in the cloud, it functions with the prerequisite of operand availability.

units.rawText: With our current strategies, we can at least efficiently eliminate the created Entropic jellyfish until she cannot create more of her kin.
units.displayText: With our current strategies, we can at least efficiently eliminate the created Entropic jellyfish until she cannot create more of her kin.

spans.text: With our current strategies, we can at least efficiently eliminate the created Entropic jellyfish until she cannot create more of her kin.

units.rawText: I hope that remains true. Sol, how are you faring?
units.displayText: I hope that remains true. Sol, how are you faring?

spans.text: I hope that remains true. Sol, how are you faring?

units.rawText: Everyone's good to go! We're ready for action!
units.displayText: Everyone's good to go! We're ready for action!

spans.text: Everyone's good to go! We're ready for action!

units.rawText: Though I do wonder where that High Order Entropic that was all smiles is...
units.displayText: Though I do wonder where that High Order Entropic that was all smiles is...

spans.text: Though I do wonder where that High Order Entropic that was all smiles is...

units.rawText: Good point. The later, the better, as a matter of fact, but judging by the speed at which the frontlines moved before, she should have arrived at the secondary defense line ages ago.
units.displayText: Good point. The later, the better, as a matter of fact, but judging by the speed at which the frontlines moved before, she should have arrived at the secondary defense line ages ago.

spans.text: Good point. The later, the better, as a matter of fact, but judging by the speed at which the frontlines moved before, she should have arrived at the secondary defense line ages ago.

units.rawText: Something feels off... Antonina, can you tell me what exactly is going on at the Sandbox Barrier?
units.displayText: Something feels off... Antonina, can you tell me what exactly is going on at the Sandbox Barrier?

spans.text: Something feels off... Antonina, can you tell me what exactly is going on at the Sandbox Barrier?

units.rawText: To prevent a repeat incident of what happened with the defense nodes, I've put Zone G's Sandbox Barrier offline.
units.displayText: To prevent a repeat incident of what happened with the defense nodes, I've put Zone G's Sandbox Barrier offline.

spans.text: To prevent a repeat incident of what happened with the defense nodes, I've put Zone G's Sandbox Barrier offline.

units.rawText: If we're being optimistic, perhaps the Sandbox Barrier's automatic retaliation system worked as intended...
units.displayText: If we're being optimistic, perhaps the Sandbox Barrier's automatic retaliation system worked as intended...

spans.text: If we're being optimistic, perhaps the Sandbox Barrier's automatic retaliation system worked as intended...

units.rawText: Hang on... Persicaria, Anna, look!
units.displayText: Hang on... Persicaria, Anna, look!

spans.text: Hang on... Persicaria, Anna, look!

units.rawText: The horizon is gradually engulfed in a shade of purple. As the purple flood grows closer, everyone saw it for what it was.
units.displayText: The horizon is gradually engulfed in a shade of purple. As the purple flood grows closer, everyone saw it for what it was.

spans.text: The horizon is gradually engulfed in a shade of purple. As the purple flood grows closer, everyone saw it for what it was.

units.rawText: It's all Entropic jellyfish...
units.displayText: It's all Entropic jellyfish...

spans.text: It's all Entropic jellyfish...

units.rawText: The purple organisms cluster together, their mass a purple sea when looking on from afar.
units.displayText: The purple organisms cluster together, their mass a purple sea when looking on from afar.

spans.text: The purple organisms cluster together, their mass a purple sea when looking on from afar.

units.rawText: That'll be trouble...
units.displayText: That'll be trouble...

spans.text: That'll be trouble...

units.rawText: Perhaps more of the Low Order Entropics have been transformed into Entropic jellyfish, but the operands they would need for that...
units.displayText: Perhaps more of the Low Order Entropics have been transformed into Entropic jellyfish, but the operands they would need for that...

spans.text: Perhaps more of the Low Order Entropics have been transformed into Entropic jellyfish, but the operands they would need for that...

units.rawText: Before they can respond, an alarm drags everyone present into an even deeper abyss.
units.displayText: Before they can respond, an alarm drags everyone present into an even deeper abyss.

spans.text: Before they can respond, an alarm drags everyone present into an even deeper abyss.

units.rawText: ...Crap, Zones F and H have received heavy damage to their Sandbox Barriers!
units.displayText: ...Crap, Zones F and H have received heavy damage to their Sandbox Barriers!

spans.text: ...Crap, Zones F and H have received heavy damage to their Sandbox Barriers!

units.rawText: Antonina calls up the archived imaging data. Low Order Entropics slither through the gap in Zone G, making for Zones F and H. The operands from the Sandbox Barrier flow into them as their bodies engorge and burst apart, leaving only Entropic fluid splattered over the barrier's surface.
units.displayText: Antonina calls up the archived imaging data. Low Order Entropics slither through the gap in Zone G, making for Zones F and H. The operands from the Sandbox Barrier flow into them as their bodies engorge and burst apart, leaving only Entropic fluid splattered over the barrier's surface.

spans.text: Antonina calls up the archived imaging data. Low Order Entropics slither through the gap in Zone G, making for Zones F and H. The operands from the Sandbox Barrier flow into them as their bodies engorge and burst apart, leaving only Entropic fluid splattered over the barrier's surface.

units.rawText: (Squelching sounds)
units.displayText: (Squelching sounds)

spans.text: (Squelching sounds)

units.rawText: That Entropic fluid soon begins to agitate and bubble, birthing jellyfish Entropics endlessly, one after the other.
units.displayText: That Entropic fluid soon begins to agitate and bubble, birthing jellyfish Entropics endlessly, one after the other.

spans.text: That Entropic fluid soon begins to agitate and bubble, birthing jellyfish Entropics endlessly, one after the other.

units.rawText: Sol hurries to meet them with a group of agents. Yet, in the face of an endlessly spawning great and vast multitude of Entropics, hope was slim to all involved.
units.displayText: Sol hurries to meet them with a group of agents. Yet, in the face of an endlessly spawning great and vast multitude of Entropics, hope was slim to all involved.

spans.text: Sol hurries to meet them with a group of agents. Yet, in the face of an endlessly spawning great and vast multitude of Entropics, hope was slim to all involved.

units.rawText: The High Order Entropic sits at the other extremity of the Entropic swarm. The Entropic line becomes wider and wider, almost wrapping around.
units.displayText: The High Order Entropic sits at the other extremity of the Entropic swarm. The Entropic line becomes wider and wider, almost wrapping around.

spans.text: The High Order Entropic sits at the other extremity of the Entropic swarm. The Entropic line becomes wider and wider, almost wrapping around.

units.rawText: Not like this... at least, I can't just watch as everyone throws themselves into the grinder...
units.displayText: Not like this... at least, I can't just watch as everyone throws themselves into the grinder...

spans.text: Not like this... at least, I can't just watch as everyone throws themselves into the grinder...

units.rawText: Persicaria mutters beneath her breath, her eyes fixating on the map in a deathly stare.
units.displayText: Persicaria mutters beneath her breath, her eyes fixating on the map in a deathly stare.

spans.text: Persicaria mutters beneath her breath, her eyes fixating on the map in a deathly stare.

units.rawText: Yet, no solution seems to exist for this predicament.
units.displayText: Yet, no solution seems to exist for this predicament.

spans.text: Yet, no solution seems to exist for this predicament.

units.rawText: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.
units.displayText: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.

spans.text: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.

units.rawText: I smooth over the white knight in my hand, my next move still uncertain.
units.displayText: I smooth over the white knight in my hand, my next move still uncertain.

spans.text: I smooth over the white knight in my hand, my next move still uncertain.

units.rawText: I have the upper hand, and a black bishop is soon to fall. My rationality reminds me constantly—that I must not be swayed by Eucharist's words.
units.displayText: I have the upper hand, and a black bishop is soon to fall. My rationality reminds me constantly—that I must not be swayed by Eucharist's words.

spans.text: I have the upper hand, and a black bishop is soon to fall. My rationality reminds me constantly—that I must not be swayed by Eucharist's words.

units.rawText: But for her to be so self-assured while at such a disadvantage, just what did she have planned?
units.displayText: But for her to be so self-assured while at such a disadvantage, just what did she have planned?

spans.text: But for her to be so self-assured while at such a disadvantage, just what did she have planned?

units.rawText: Taking our time with this one, hmm? Hehe, I understand how you feel.
units.displayText: Taking our time with this one, hmm? Hehe, I understand how you feel.

spans.text: Taking our time with this one, hmm? Hehe, I understand how you feel.

units.rawText: It's just that your time is running short.
units.displayText: It's just that your time is running short.

spans.text: It's just that your time is running short.

units.rawText: Eucharist taps at the game clock, making a thumping sound. The white side's hand continues to tick away as if reminding me of what little time remains.
units.displayText: Eucharist taps at the game clock, making a thumping sound. The white side's hand continues to tick away as if reminding me of what little time remains.

spans.text: Eucharist taps at the game clock, making a thumping sound. The white side's hand continues to tick away as if reminding me of what little time remains.

units.rawText: Is the anxiety getting to you?
units.displayText: Is the anxiety getting to you?

spans.text: Is the anxiety getting to you?

units.rawText: You should be the anxious one here, no? I'm only reminding you out of the goodness of my heart.
units.displayText: You should be the anxious one here, no? I'm only reminding you out of the goodness of my heart.

spans.text: You should be the anxious one here, no? I'm only reminding you out of the goodness of my heart.

units.rawText: Struggling to fathom why Eucharist remains confident, I ponder for a period but ultimately capture the black bishop as I previously intended.
units.displayText: Struggling to fathom why Eucharist remains confident, I ponder for a period but ultimately capture the black bishop as I previously intended.

spans.text: Struggling to fathom why Eucharist remains confident, I ponder for a period but ultimately capture the black bishop as I previously intended.

units.rawText: Well, seems that you've made a misstep in your haste, Professor.
units.displayText: Well, seems that you've made a misstep in your haste, Professor.

spans.text: Well, seems that you've made a misstep in your haste, Professor.

units.rawText: Always looking outside the game will lead you to blunder, you know.
units.displayText: Always looking outside the game will lead you to blunder, you know.

spans.text: Always looking outside the game will lead you to blunder, you know.

units.rawText: Eucharist moves a black bishop in attack, capturing the white knight. I suddenly found myself under siege on several fronts, advantage quickly turning into dilemma.
units.displayText: Eucharist moves a black bishop in attack, capturing the white knight. I suddenly found myself under siege on several fronts, advantage quickly turning into dilemma.

spans.text: Eucharist moves a black bishop in attack, capturing the white knight. I suddenly found myself under siege on several fronts, advantage quickly turning into dilemma.

units.rawText: Hehe, you've come around faster than I expected. Unfortunately, it's still too slow, Professor.
units.displayText: Hehe, you've come around faster than I expected. Unfortunately, it's still too slow, Professor.

spans.text: Hehe, you've come around faster than I expected. Unfortunately, it's still too slow, Professor.

units.rawText: The moment it comes into contact with the black bishop, the white pieces slowly begin to corrode and melt, disintegrating into purple Entropic fluid, slowly flowing off the board.
units.displayText: The moment it comes into contact with the black bishop, the white pieces slowly begin to corrode and melt, disintegrating into purple Entropic fluid, slowly flowing off the board.

spans.text: The moment it comes into contact with the black bishop, the white pieces slowly begin to corrode and melt, disintegrating into purple Entropic fluid, slowly flowing off the board.

units.rawText: As if it had received some sort of input, the delicate sound of singing fills the space, gradually growing more and more vigorous.
units.displayText: As if it had received some sort of input, the delicate sound of singing fills the space, gradually growing more and more vigorous.

spans.text: As if it had received some sort of input, the delicate sound of singing fills the space, gradually growing more and more vigorous.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Come! Come! Sing with us!</color>
units.displayText: Come! Come! Sing with us!

spans.text: Come! Come! Sing with us!

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Come! Come! Dance with us!</color>
units.displayText: Come! Come! Dance with us!

spans.text: Come! Come! Dance with us!

units.rawText: As the song proceeds, the Low Order Entropics liquefy one by one, flowing into the Entropic liquid. Soon after, countless Entropic jellyfish arise from the liquid.
units.displayText: As the song proceeds, the Low Order Entropics liquefy one by one, flowing into the Entropic liquid. Soon after, countless Entropic jellyfish arise from the liquid.

spans.text: As the song proceeds, the Low Order Entropics liquefy one by one, flowing into the Entropic liquid. Soon after, countless Entropic jellyfish arise from the liquid.

units.rawText: Eucharist, what did you send to the Oasis?
units.displayText: Eucharist, what did you send to the Oasis?

spans.text: Eucharist, what did you send to the Oasis?

units.rawText: Hehe, who knows~ Looks like the dance has already begun.
units.displayText: Hehe, who knows~ Looks like the dance has already begun.

spans.text: Hehe, who knows~ Looks like the dance has already begun.

units.rawText: The jellyfish Entropics oscillate their bodies in a motion akin to dancing.
units.displayText: The jellyfish Entropics oscillate their bodies in a motion akin to dancing.

spans.text: The jellyfish Entropics oscillate their bodies in a motion akin to dancing.

units.rawText: ...A brilliant counterattack.
units.displayText: ...A brilliant counterattack.

spans.text: ...A brilliant counterattack.

units.rawText: Hehe, thank you. What a shame that you have no more ways out, Professor.
units.displayText: Hehe, thank you. What a shame that you have no more ways out, Professor.

spans.text: Hehe, thank you. What a shame that you have no more ways out, Professor.

units.rawText: The remaining foreseeable continuations would all lead to a deadlock, the white pieces confined by the black ones.
units.displayText: The remaining foreseeable continuations would all lead to a deadlock, the white pieces confined by the black ones.

spans.text: The remaining foreseeable continuations would all lead to a deadlock, the white pieces confined by the black ones.

units.rawText: What shall you do next?
units.displayText: What shall you do next?

spans.text: What shall you do next?

options.rawText: If you can sacrifice pieces, then I can do the same for the sake of victory.
options.displayText: If you can sacrifice pieces, then I can do the same for the sake of victory.

spans.text: If you can sacrifice pieces, then I can do the same for the sake of victory.

options.rawText: If you would stake lives on this game, then you had better see it through.
options.displayText: If you would stake lives on this game, then you had better see it through.

spans.text: If you would stake lives on this game, then you had better see it through.

units.rawText: Think about it carefully, Professor. The pieces you sacrifice are bound to your very life.
units.displayText: Think about it carefully, Professor. The pieces you sacrifice are bound to your very life.

spans.text: Think about it carefully, Professor. The pieces you sacrifice are bound to your very life.

units.rawText: As you wish, then, if that is how you will put it.
units.displayText: As you wish, then, if that is how you will put it.

spans.text: As you wish, then, if that is how you will put it.

units.rawText: Eucharist's legs bob back and forth some more as the Entropic liquid squirms further up my leg.
units.displayText: Eucharist's legs bob back and forth some more as the Entropic liquid squirms further up my leg.

spans.text: Eucharist's legs bob back and forth some more as the Entropic liquid squirms further up my leg.

units.rawText: The minor Entropization strikes me with a wave of nausea as I fight through it to lift a piece.
units.displayText: The minor Entropization strikes me with a wave of nausea as I fight through it to lift a piece.

spans.text: The minor Entropization strikes me with a wave of nausea as I fight through it to lift a piece.

units.rawText: Back.
units.displayText: Back.

spans.text: Back.

units.rawText: The Oasis, Zone G secondary defense line, temporary command center.
units.displayText: The Oasis, Zone G secondary defense line, temporary command center.

spans.text: The Oasis, Zone G secondary defense line, temporary command center.

units.rawText: They're pushing up again!
units.displayText: They're pushing up again!

spans.text: They're pushing up again!

units.rawText: The sounds of strife come through the comms. The cries of agents can be heard, replete with resolve, courage, and pain. Countless agents fall as they are injured but pick themselves back up.
units.displayText: The sounds of strife come through the comms. The cries of agents can be heard, replete with resolve, courage, and pain. Countless agents fall as they are injured but pick themselves back up.

spans.text: The sounds of strife come through the comms. The cries of agents can be heard, replete with resolve, courage, and pain. Countless agents fall as they are injured but pick themselves back up.

units.rawText: Avoid falling too deep into enemy lines. Pull back! Medic teams, be ready!
units.displayText: Avoid falling too deep into enemy lines. Pull back! Medic teams, be ready!

spans.text: Avoid falling too deep into enemy lines. Pull back! Medic teams, be ready!

units.rawText: Persicaria, this cannot continue for long.
units.displayText: Persicaria, this cannot continue for long.

spans.text: Persicaria, this cannot continue for long.

units.rawText: The enemy pushes forward far faster than we estimated. The pre-deployed ordnance can eliminate a portion of the jellyfish Entropics, but with the Sandbox Barrier acting as their supply, they'll simply continue to spawn.
units.displayText: The enemy pushes forward far faster than we estimated. The pre-deployed ordnance can eliminate a portion of the jellyfish Entropics, but with the Sandbox Barrier acting as their supply, they'll simply continue to spawn.

spans.text: The enemy pushes forward far faster than we estimated. The pre-deployed ordnance can eliminate a portion of the jellyfish Entropics, but with the Sandbox Barrier acting as their supply, they'll simply continue to spawn.

units.rawText: If we retreat any further, we might even walk into an encirclement.
units.displayText: If we retreat any further, we might even walk into an encirclement.

spans.text: If we retreat any further, we might even walk into an encirclement.

units.rawText: But you know how the current situation is. We put in everything we had, and we couldn't even get past their defensive lines, much less touch the High Order Entropic.
units.displayText: But you know how the current situation is. We put in everything we had, and we couldn't even get past their defensive lines, much less touch the High Order Entropic.

spans.text: But you know how the current situation is. We put in everything we had, and we couldn't even get past their defensive lines, much less touch the High Order Entropic.

units.rawText: Asking people to put themselves on the line under these circumstances is akin to sentencing them to death!
units.displayText: Asking people to put themselves on the line under these circumstances is akin to sentencing them to death!

spans.text: Asking people to put themselves on the line under these circumstances is akin to sentencing them to death!

units.rawText: I understand... but we have no other options.
units.displayText: I understand... but we have no other options.

spans.text: I understand... but we have no other options.

units.rawText: We do.
units.displayText: We do.

spans.text: We do.

units.rawText: Persicaria spoke softly, but her tone was firm.
units.displayText: Persicaria spoke softly, but her tone was firm.

spans.text: Persicaria spoke softly, but her tone was firm.

units.rawText: Scorched earth.
units.displayText: Scorched earth.

spans.text: Scorched earth.

units.rawText: ...You'd abandon the Oasis?
units.displayText: ...You'd abandon the Oasis?

spans.text: ...You'd abandon the Oasis?

units.rawText: I've planned a route to the Enigma Sector. Neumann will receive us there. The Entropic infestation there is mild, and the Sanctifiers' forces are close by.
units.displayText: I've planned a route to the Enigma Sector. Neumann will receive us there. The Entropic infestation there is mild, and the Sanctifiers' forces are close by.

spans.text: I've planned a route to the Enigma Sector. Neumann will receive us there. The Entropic infestation there is mild, and the Sanctifiers' forces are close by.

units.rawText: If we can reach Enigma, we will at least have room to maneuver...
units.displayText: If we can reach Enigma, we will at least have room to maneuver...

spans.text: If we can reach Enigma, we will at least have room to maneuver...

units.rawText: Even if it will come with the Oasis as the cost?!
units.displayText: Even if it will come with the Oasis as the cost?!

spans.text: Even if it will come with the Oasis as the cost?!

units.rawText: Sorry. I know I promised the Professor...
units.displayText: Sorry. I know I promised the Professor...

spans.text: Sorry. I know I promised the Professor...

units.rawText: Persicaria looks at the wounded next to her. With the sheer amount of casualties, the temporary command center has been repurposed for the wounded. With the speed of the enemy advance, even the medical team in the command center may soon be forced to transfer.
units.displayText: Persicaria looks at the wounded next to her. With the sheer amount of casualties, the temporary command center has been repurposed for the wounded. With the speed of the enemy advance, even the medical team in the command center may soon be forced to transfer.

spans.text: Persicaria looks at the wounded next to her. With the sheer amount of casualties, the temporary command center has been repurposed for the wounded. With the speed of the enemy advance, even the medical team in the command center may soon be forced to transfer.

units.rawText: The heavily injured uncontrollably groan and wail, submerging the already cramped space in pain and misery. Many of the medical personnel couldn't stand to watch any longer and put agents into forced hibernation.
units.displayText: The heavily injured uncontrollably groan and wail, submerging the already cramped space in pain and misery. Many of the medical personnel couldn't stand to watch any longer and put agents into forced hibernation.

spans.text: The heavily injured uncontrollably groan and wail, submerging the already cramped space in pain and misery. Many of the medical personnel couldn't stand to watch any longer and put agents into forced hibernation.

units.rawText: We have no other choice. Home is only home when we still have companions at our side.
units.displayText: We have no other choice. Home is only home when we still have companions at our side.

spans.text: We have no other choice. Home is only home when we still have companions at our side.

units.rawText: But without the Oasis, even if we do successfully evacuate, where'll we go after that?
units.displayText: But without the Oasis, even if we do successfully evacuate, where'll we go after that?

spans.text: But without the Oasis, even if we do successfully evacuate, where'll we go after that?

units.rawText: I don't know. But at least... we need to weather this storm!
units.displayText: I don't know. But at least... we need to weather this storm!

spans.text: I don't know. But at least... we need to weather this storm!

units.rawText: Persicaria! Calm down!
units.displayText: Persicaria! Calm down!

spans.text: Persicaria! Calm down!

units.rawText: Sol? You...
units.displayText: Sol? You...

spans.text: Sol? You...

units.rawText: Seeing someone supposed to be in the heat of the frontlines by her side, Persicaria was forced to take a moment to collect herself.
units.displayText: Seeing someone supposed to be in the heat of the frontlines by her side, Persicaria was forced to take a moment to collect herself.

spans.text: Seeing someone supposed to be in the heat of the frontlines by her side, Persicaria was forced to take a moment to collect herself.

units.rawText: You forgot to cut the call—no, I should say thank goodness you forgot to cut the call.
units.displayText: You forgot to cut the call—no, I should say thank goodness you forgot to cut the call.

spans.text: You forgot to cut the call—no, I should say thank goodness you forgot to cut the call.

units.rawText: I think Persicaria could do with a field report and a little heart to heart.
units.displayText: I think Persicaria could do with a field report and a little heart to heart.

spans.text: I think Persicaria could do with a field report and a little heart to heart.

units.rawText: Sol hastily wipes away bloodstains on her body before tightly gripping Persicaria's hand.
units.displayText: Sol hastily wipes away bloodstains on her body before tightly gripping Persicaria's hand.

spans.text: Sol hastily wipes away bloodstains on her body before tightly gripping Persicaria's hand.

units.rawText: Eh?
units.displayText: Eh?

spans.text: Eh?

units.rawText: Look, I'm still here, and I can keep going!
units.displayText: Look, I'm still here, and I can keep going!

spans.text: Look, I'm still here, and I can keep going!

units.rawText: There's no need for sacrifices, and it's not time to give up yet. We can still hold them for some time.
units.displayText: There's no need for sacrifices, and it's not time to give up yet. We can still hold them for some time.

spans.text: There's no need for sacrifices, and it's not time to give up yet. We can still hold them for some time.

units.rawText: No... in the worst-case scenario, there'll be nothing we can do.
units.displayText: No... in the worst-case scenario, there'll be nothing we can do.

spans.text: No... in the worst-case scenario, there'll be nothing we can do.

units.rawText: We've had enough situations where there was nothing to be done, but we're still here.
units.displayText: We've had enough situations where there was nothing to be done, but we're still here.

spans.text: We've had enough situations where there was nothing to be done, but we're still here.

units.rawText: Feeling the temperature from Sol's palm, a certain warm strength flows into Persicaria.
units.displayText: Feeling the temperature from Sol's palm, a certain warm strength flows into Persicaria.

spans.text: Feeling the temperature from Sol's palm, a certain warm strength flows into Persicaria.

units.rawText: Take this time to think while you can. See if there are any other ways to go about this. I can give you some more time.
units.displayText: Take this time to think while you can. See if there are any other ways to go about this. I can give you some more time.

spans.text: Take this time to think while you can. See if there are any other ways to go about this. I can give you some more time.

units.rawText: I can't just gamble with everyone's lives...
units.displayText: I can't just gamble with everyone's lives...

spans.text: I can't just gamble with everyone's lives...

units.rawText: Relax. If we really can't endure any longer, I'll accept a retreat. But that time is not now.
units.displayText: Relax. If we really can't endure any longer, I'll accept a retreat. But that time is not now.

spans.text: Relax. If we really can't endure any longer, I'll accept a retreat. But that time is not now.

units.rawText: I agree with Sol. And... as much as I hate to admit it, maybe <cmdr>'ll turn it around for us somehow.
units.displayText: I agree with Sol. And... as much as I hate to admit it, maybe {교수}'ll turn it around for us somehow.

spans.text: I agree with Sol. And... as much as I hate to admit it, maybe
'll turn it around for us somehow.

units.rawText: ...Alright.
units.displayText: ...Alright.

spans.text: ...Alright.

units.rawText: Persicaria glimpses at the approaching Entropic swarm.
units.displayText: Persicaria glimpses at the approaching Entropic swarm.

spans.text: Persicaria glimpses at the approaching Entropic swarm.

units.rawText: We still have the option of retreat available. Before we're well and truly surrounded, there may be room to struggle.
units.displayText: We still have the option of retreat available. Before we're well and truly surrounded, there may be room to struggle.

spans.text: We still have the option of retreat available. Before we're well and truly surrounded, there may be room to struggle.

units.rawText: But if we get to the stage where there is nothing we can do to fight back, we must be prepared to immediately retreat.
units.displayText: But if we get to the stage where there is nothing we can do to fight back, we must be prepared to immediately retreat.

spans.text: But if we get to the stage where there is nothing we can do to fight back, we must be prepared to immediately retreat.

units.rawText: Got it! I'll hold on for a little longer with everyone.
units.displayText: Got it! I'll hold on for a little longer with everyone.

spans.text: Got it! I'll hold on for a little longer with everyone.

units.rawText: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.
units.displayText: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.

spans.text: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.

units.rawText: Yaaaaaaawn.
units.displayText: Yaaaaaaawn.

spans.text: Yaaaaaaawn.

units.rawText: These battles of attrition are so dull, Professor. Compared to toughing it out here, wouldn't you be better off just surrendering?
units.displayText: These battles of attrition are so dull, Professor. Compared to toughing it out here, wouldn't you be better off just surrendering?

spans.text: These battles of attrition are so dull, Professor. Compared to toughing it out here, wouldn't you be better off just surrendering?

units.rawText: You're not stalling for time anymore?
units.displayText: You're not stalling for time anymore?

spans.text: You're not stalling for time anymore?

units.rawText: With how stacked the odds are, I don't think that's necessary anymore.
units.displayText: With how stacked the odds are, I don't think that's necessary anymore.

spans.text: With how stacked the odds are, I don't think that's necessary anymore.

units.rawText: Oh? Judging by that expression, do you have some other surprise left in store, Professor?
units.displayText: Oh? Judging by that expression, do you have some other surprise left in store, Professor?

spans.text: Oh? Judging by that expression, do you have some other surprise left in store, Professor?

units.rawText: How could you forget the very rules you dictated?
units.displayText: How could you forget the very rules you dictated?

spans.text: How could you forget the very rules you dictated?

units.rawText: I took your piece earlier, but I haven't sent a message yet.
units.displayText: I took your piece earlier, but I haven't sent a message yet.

spans.text: I took your piece earlier, but I haven't sent a message yet.

units.rawText: You really think a single message is enough to turn the tide... alright.
units.displayText: You really think a single message is enough to turn the tide... alright.

spans.text: You really think a single message is enough to turn the tide... alright.

units.rawText: Eucharist raises an eyebrow, looking at me pompously.
units.displayText: Eucharist raises an eyebrow, looking at me pompously.

spans.text: Eucharist raises an eyebrow, looking at me pompously.

units.rawText: I will enjoy your final struggles, then. Please, if you would.
units.displayText: I will enjoy your final struggles, then. Please, if you would.

spans.text: I will enjoy your final struggles, then. Please, if you would.
